title: fix: support time ranges crossing midnight
body:
This PR fixes a bug where time ranges spanning across midnight (e.g., `23:00-01:00`) were calculated incorrectly as negative durations.

- Updated `parseLine` to add 1 day to the end time (`to`) if it is before the start time (`from`).
- Added corresponding test case for midnight crossing.

---
*🤖 Authored by Lango*
head: fix/midnight-parsing
